svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SPI timing with the wake handshake
svg.desc: SPI timing of the BNO08x in mode 3: the host pulls WAKE low, the hub answers with H_INTN low, the host selects it with H_CSN and clocks bytes MSB first on CLK, and H_INTN rises once the select is seen.
svg.text: SPI timing with the wake handshake
SPI mode 3 (CPOL 1, CPHA 1). Datasheet: 6.5.2 SPI timing, p. 47; 6.5.4
Interrupt timing, p. 48; 1.2.4.2 SPI Operation, p. 19; 1.2.4.1 Responding to
Hub wakeup from the wake signal
Answer H_INTN within about 10 ms, or the BNO085/BNO086 times out
